title: BACKPACK FULL SAYS WHAT TO PRESS
why: His order of 2026-10-09: raid text reads like a shooter HUD, short caps callouts, never an explaining sentence. The review of the fourth batch of raid text found the BACKPACK FULL detail still a sentence, [Z] drops the selected item., and not even true where it was read: Z drops only with the backpack open, and the pickup stack shows only with it shut. It now reads [B] BACKPACK then [Z] DROP (on a controller [VIEW] BACKPACK then [Y] DROP), and the same with autoloot on, where it used to say nothing was left worth dropping while rare items could still be dropped by hand. The stall refusal NOT ENOUGH BANKED CREDITS now reads Costs and the price, then Carrying and the stall money on him, instead of a sentence repeating that it is not banked. The SOLD line keeps Worth and the carried home figure: it is a short detail with the number he needs, as the raid text design allows.
now: BACKPACK FULL now says which key opens the backpack and which drops an item, and the stall refusal shows the price and the money you carry.

edits.anchor: function bagDropHint(){ return padOn()?padB('[Y] drops the selected item.'):('['+keyLabel('KeyZ','Z')+'] drops the selected item.'); }

edits.replacement: say('BACKPACK FULL','pick',{key:'bagfull',c:'danger',sub:bagDropHint()});   // v22.xx (tr4fixc): the shooter voice, autoloot too

edits.anchor: if((P.credits||0)<st.price){ say('NOT ENOUGH BANKED CREDITS','info',{sub:'Costs '+'$'+st.price.toLocaleString()+'.'+((G.pedCarry||0)>0?(' '+'$'+(G.pedCarry||0).toLocaleString()+' carried is not banked.'):'')}); return; }
edits.replacement: if((P.credits||0)<st.price){ say('NOT ENOUGH BANKED CREDITS','info',{sub:'Costs '+'$'+st.price.toLocaleString()+'.'+((G.pedCarry||0)>0?(' Carrying '+'$'+(G.pedCarry||0).toLocaleString()+'.'):'')}); return; }   // v22.xx (tr4fixc): the shooter voice, the headline says banked
